metadata.case_name: NG KAI HO v. WONG KING FAI T/A WING TAK CONSTRUCTIONS AND ENGINEERING AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_after: 24T lorry driver (driving only, no manual work)

injuries.description: left forearm laceration with tendon cut (60% cut of FCR tendon)
source: Physical examination revealed a 3cm laceration on the left arm.
60% cut of flexor carpi radialis (FCR) tendon at musculotendinous junction was revealed and repaired.
left forearm laceration with tendon cut (60% cut of FCR tendon) was compatible and consistent with the mechanism of the injury given by the plaintiff.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration of other flexor muscle, fascia or tendon at forearm level

manifestations.description: Numbness around scar with sense of discomfort.
He avoids using this left upper limb.
The maximal weight he can lift is around 30kg.
6 cm oblique scar over volar aspect of mid forearm, well healed.
Tenderness at scar over flexor carpi radialis (FCR) area.
50% reduction in sensation to touch over volar forearm and distal to scar.
Residual scar discomfort and sensory deficit.
Reduction in work efficiency and capacity chiefly on heavy manual work or when he has to operate vehicles fitted with manual gear.

treatments_received.treatment: Repair of 60% cut of flexor carpi radialis (FCR) tendon at musculotendinous junction
source: 60% cut of flexor carpi radialis (FCR) tendon at musculotendinous junction was revealed and repaired. Splint was fitted after the operation.
treatments_received.vmis_procedure: Tendon repair / Suture of tendon of hand

source: 60% cut of flexor carpi radialis (FCR) tendon at musculotendinous junction was revealed and repaired. Splint was fitted after the operation.

treatments_received.treatment: Physiotherapy (referred to United Christian Hospital on 15 July 2013; defaulted after 31 July 2013)
source: He was referred to the physiotherapy department at United Christian Hospital (“UCH”) on 15 July 2013. He defaulted treatment after 31 July 2013. [A129]

treatments_received.treatment: Occupational therapy work capacity evaluation at AHMLNH (referred 23 September 2013; intake assessment 28 October 2013)
source: He was referred to occupational therapy department at AHMLNH on 23 September 2013 for work capacity evaluation.
During the intake assessment on 28 October 2013, the plaintiff claimed that he did not have sufficient strength to resume work as his job as driver and material handler requires...

treatments_received.treatment: Admission to Orthopaedic ward of Alice Ho Miu Ling Nethersole Hospital and discharge the following day (6 June 2013)
source: He was then admitted to the Orthopaedic ward of AHMLNH where 60% cut of flexor carpi radialis (FCR) tendon at musculotendinous junction was revealed and repaired. Splint was fitted after the operation.
The plaintiff was discharged from AHMLNH the following day, ie on 6 June 2013.

losses.description: Residual left forearm scar discomfort, sensory deficit and reduced work efficiency and capacity chiefly on heavy manual work or when he has to operate vehicles fitted with manual gear.
6 cm oblique scar over volar aspect of mid forearm, well healed.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
